triage_names: Pavel Gorenko — Compound fracture, left tibia. Survived Day 12.
Katya Morozova — Second-degree flash burns. Given sulfur salve.
Sgt. Ilya Taras — Inhaled hot smoke. Lungs cleared Day 18.
Dmitri Vane — Acute thyroid swelling. First potassium iodide dose.
Elena Surova — Malnutrition, third week. Shared flour broth.
Old Man Kroll — Hypothermia, wet boots. Feet saved by friction.
Marta Belova — Shrapnel wound, shoulder. Iron fragment extracted.
Little Sonya — Mild conjunctivitis. Eyewash from melted snow.
Yakov the Miller — Torn tendon. Splinted with oak lathe.
Vera Danilova — Deep lacerations. Sutured with linen thread.
Boris the Baker — Inhaled flour dust and ash. Breather valve issued.
Anna Voronova — Shock tremor. Sedated with valerian root.
Cpl. Mikhail Reznov — Concussion, blunt trauma. Monitored 48 hours.
Zoya Volkova — Cracked ribs. Chest bound with linen strips.
Grigory Morozov — Acid burns, canal lock. Saline wash administered.
Tanya Koroleva — Scurvy, early lesions. Pine needle tea prescribed.
Stepan the Sapper — Blast concussions, ear drum ruptured.
Oleg the Blacksmith — Molten lead splash. Skin graft from forearm.
Larisa Petrova — Dysentery. Boiled willow bark and charcoal given.
Nikolai the Drover — Frostbite, right toes. Amputation avoided.
Valeri Voss — Exhaustion, acute stress. 12 hours dark bunk mandated.
Kira the Weaver — Punctured palm. Disinfected with carbolic acid.
Lev the Cooper — Crushed fingers. Bound with splint and pitch.
Nadezhda the Archivist — Smoke inhalation. Oxygen administered.
Fyodor the Stoker — Boiler flash burns. Zinc ointment dressing.
Polina the Scout — Radiation nausea, 0.4 Gy. Prussian blue regimen.
Viktor the Machinist — Metal splinter in cornea. Removed with magnet.
Darya the Cook — Steam scalds, both arms. Cold compress applied.
Anton the Courier — Blisters, long march through ash. Lanced and dressed.
Sofiya the Orphan — Severe dehydration. Electrolyte solution spoon-fed.
Unidentified Boy from Sector 4 — Found by intake vent. Warmed and fed.
